title: 第15章 不威严徒弟冲师怎么办第16章 难道真有人会怕蓝银缠绕
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
墨渊的身躯逐渐变得透明。
“我确实有过夺舍你念头，但既然你有能力振兴墨家，那未来应该交给年轻人才是。”
他目光复杂，有悲哀，有欣慰，有期待，种种情绪交织在一起，最终化作一声叹息。
墨羽也明白了他的意思。
人之将死，其言也善。
心中涌起一股难以言喻滋味，他最终还是开口。
“可惜，前辈，我并不是真正意义上的墨家人，我是被原本家族遗弃到墨村的，你墨家的血脉终究是无法传承下去。”
墨渊微微一怔，随即似是明白了什么，笑容愈发灿烂。
“我不会看错，我守在这里无数年，从未错过。”
他深深地凝视着墨羽。
“小心，最慢五百年，天元大陆将有一场大劫。”
他声音越来越轻，越来越飘渺。
最终，他话语随着他的灵魂，一同消散。
只留下一枚散发着淡淡光芒魂丹，静静地悬浮在半空。
墨羽闻言，微微出神。
“从不屑于欺骗吗？”
回想起之前墨渊说过的话，他低声呢喃。
所以，墨渊认定他有墨家血脉。
那场大劫难，也确实在五百年内。
也就是说，墨村其实只是墨家的起源地？

那么他其实是上界墨家的人？
又是一个经典模板。
墨羽内心吐槽。
魂丹缓缓漂浮到他面前，他这才回过神来，伸手轻轻接住。
入手冰凉，却有一股暖流顺着掌心涌入体内。
他对着墨渊消失的地方微微躬身。
“晚辈必定不会辜负先祖厚望。”

content_en:
Mo Yuan's body gradually became transparent.
"I did have the idea of seizing you, but since you have the ability to revitalize the Mo family, the future should be left to young people."
His eyes were complicated, including sadness, relief, and expectation. All kinds of emotions were intertwined together, and finally turned into a sigh.
Mo Yu also understood what he meant.
When a person is about to die, his words are also good.
With an indescribable feeling welling up in his heart, he finally spoke.
"Unfortunately, senior, I am not a member of the Mo family in the true sense. I was abandoned to Mo Village by my original family. After all, the blood of your Mo family cannot be passed on."
Mo Yuan was startled for a moment, then seemed to understand something, and his smile became brighter.
"I can't be wrong. I've been here for countless years and never missed it."
He stared at Mo Yu deeply.
"Be careful, there will be a catastrophe in Tianyuan Continent within five hundred years at the earliest."
His voice became softer and softer, more and more ethereal.
In the end, his words disappeared along with his soul.
There was only one soul elixir left that exuded a faint light, floating quietly in the air.
Hearing this, Mo Yu was slightly in a trance.
"Never bother to deceive?"
Recalling what Mo Yuan had said before, he murmured in a low voice.
Therefore, Mo Yuan believed that he had the blood of the Mo family.
That great catastrophe will indeed occur within five hundred years.
In other words, Mo Village is actually just the origin of the Mo family?
So he is actually from the Mo family in the upper realm?
Another classic template.
Mo Yu complained inwardly.
The soul pill slowly floated in front of him. Only then did he come back to his senses and reach out to gently catch it.
It was cold in the hand, but a warm current flowed into the body along the palm.
He bowed slightly towards the place where Mo Yuan disappeared.
"The younger generation will definitely live up to the high expectations of our ancestors."
